name: models3d_complete
description: Rebuild hidden geometry of Tripo-segmented parts. Requires a completed models3d_segment result; arbitrary meshes cannot be completed.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

partNames.description: Segmented GLB node names (tripo_part_0, etc). Omit for every part; max 64.
